description: Function ABI/calling convention.
Sets the underlying class implementation as `abstract`.
Forces private access to package, type or field. See [lf-access-control](https://haxe.org/manual/lf-access-control.html).
Allows private access from package, type or field. See [lf-access-control](https://haxe.org/manual/lf-access-control.html).
Used to configure the static analyzer.

Annotation (`@interface`) definitions on `--java-lib` imports will be annotated with
            this metadata. Has no effect on types compiled by Haxe.
Allows array access on an abstract. See [types-abstract-array-access](https://haxe.org/manual/types-abstract-array-access.html).
Used to declare a native C# assembly attribute
Used to declare a native C# assembly attribute; is type checked
Filled by the compiler with the parsed expression of the field.
Extends `@:build` metadata to all extending and implementing classes. See [macro-auto-build](https://haxe.org/manual/macro-auto-build.html).
Override SWF class declaration.
Embeds given bitmap data into the class (must extend `flash.display.BitmapData`). See [target-flash-resources](https://haxe.org/manual/target-flash-resources.html).
Creates native property bridges for all Haxe properties in this class.
Builds a class, enum, or abstract from a macro. See [macro-type-building](https://haxe.org/manual/macro-type-building.html).
Specify XML data to be injected into `Build.xml`.
Do not call property accessor method and access the field directly. See [class-field-property](https://haxe.org/manual/class-field-property.html).
Abstract forwards call to its underlying type.
Used to inject platform-native code into a class.
Declares an abstract operator as commutative. See [types-abstract-operator-overloading](https://haxe.org/manual/types-abstract-operator-overloading.html).
Allows a type parameter to accept expression values.
Identifies this class as a core API class (forces API check).
Identifies an abstract as core type so that it requires no implementation. See [types-abstract-core-type](https://haxe.org/manual/types-abstract-core-type.html).
Code to be injected into generated cpp file.
File to be included in generated cpp file.
Add using directives to your module
Forces dead code elimination even when `--dce full` is not specified. See [cr-dce](https://haxe.org/manual/cr-dce.html).
Forces debug information to be generated into the SWF even without `--debug`.
Automatically added by `--net-lib` on delegates.
Mark a type or field as deprecated.
Forces typedefs to be followed early.
Defines finite value sets to abstract definitions. See [types-abstract-enum](https://haxe.org/manual/types-abstract-enum.html).
Automatically added by `--net-lib` on events. Has no effect on types compiled by Haxe.
Includes the class or field in Haxe exports (default name is the classpath). See [target-javascript-expose](https://haxe.org/manual/target-javascript-expose.html).
Marks the field as extern so it is not generated.

Includes a given binary file into the target SWF and associates it with the class (must extend `flash.utils.ByteArray`).
            See [target-flash-resources](https://haxe.org/manual/target-flash-resources.html).
Include a given XML attribute snippet in the `Build.xml` entry for the file.

Prevents a class or interface from being extended or a method from being overridden. Deprecated by the
            keyword `final`. See [class-field-final](https://haxe.org/manual/class-field-final.html).
Declares an anonymous object to have fixed fields.
Embeds the given TrueType font into the class (must extend `flash.text.Font`). See [target-flash-resources](https://haxe.org/manual/target-flash-resources.html).
Forwards field access to underlying type. See [types-abstract-forward](https://haxe.org/manual/types-abstract-forward.html).
Forwards constructor call to underlying type.
Forwards static field access to underlying type. See [types-abstract-forward](https://haxe.org/manual/types-abstract-forward.html).
Forwards variance unification to underlying type.

Specifies that the field of the abstract is a cast operation from the type identified in the function. See
            [types-abstract-implicit-casts](https://haxe.org/manual/types-abstract-implicit-casts.html).
Used to inject platform-native code into a function.

Marks a class or class field as generic so each type parameter combination generates its own type/field. See
            [type-system-generic](https://haxe.org/manual/type-system-generic.html).
Builds instances of a type using the specified macro.
Makes compiler generate separate class per generic static method specialization
Generates a native getter function on the given field.
Allows extending classes marked as `@:final`. Not guaranteed to work on all targets.
Code to be injected into the generated class, in the header.
Code to be injected into the generated header file.
File to be included in generated header file.
Specifies `hdll` name and function prefix for native functions.
Annotates that an extern class was generated by Haxe.
Causes a field to be kept by DCE if the given feature is part of the compilation. See [cr-dce](https://haxe.org/manual/cr-dce.html).
Generates python import statement for extern classes.

Append documentation from a parent field or class (if used without an argument) or from a specified class or
            field (if used like @:inheritDoc(pack.Some.field)).
Inserted by the parser in case of `inline expr` and `inline function`.
Generates the annotated field/class with 'internal' access.
Forces a physical field to be generated for properties that otherwise would not require one. See [class-field-property-rules](https://haxe.org/manual/class-field-property-rules.html).
Used by the Java target to annotate the canonical path of the type.
Equivalent to the default modifier of the Java language
Mark generated class, field or method as synthetic
Generate JavaScript module require expression for given extern. See [target-javascript-require](https://haxe.org/manual/target-javascript-require.html).
Generate Lua module require expression for given extern.

Indicates that the given extern type instance should have dot-style invocation for methods instead of
            colon.
Causes a field or type to be kept by DCE. See [cr-dce](https://haxe.org/manual/cr-dce.html).
Causes a class to be kept by DCE even if all its field are removed. See [cr-dce](https://haxe.org/manual/cr-dce.html).
Extends `@:keep` metadata to all implementing and extending classes. See [cr-dce](https://haxe.org/manual/cr-dce.html).
Used as a result of inline XML parsing. See [lf-markup](lf-markup).
(deprecated)
Merge the annotated block into the current scope.
Annotates an extern class as the result of multi-return function. See [target-lua-multireturns](https://haxe.org/manual/target-lua-multireturns.html).
Specifies that an abstract chooses its this-type from its `@:to` functions.
Rewrites the path of a type or class field during generation. See [lf-externs](https://haxe.org/manual/lf-externs.html).
Annotates that a function has implementation in native code through JNI.

Annotates that all children from a type should be treated as if it were an extern definition - platform
            native.
Annotates that a type should be treated as if it were an extern definition - platform native.
Use native properties which will execute even with dynamic usage.
Converts static function syntax into member call.
Prevents the compiler from suggesting completion on this field or type. See [cr-completion](https://haxe.org/manual/cr-completion.html).
Prevents a method or all methods in a class from being used as a value.
Does not generate debug information even if `--debug` is set.
Prevents a type or field from being included in documentation generation.
Prevents a static field from being imported with `import Class.*`.
Declares function to be non-virtual in cpp.
Disallow private access to anything for the annotated expression.
Declares an abstract type as not accepting null values. See [types-nullability](https://haxe.org/manual/types-nullability.html).
Prevents a field from being used with static extension. See [lf-static-extension](https://haxe.org/manual/lf-static-extension.html).

Enables null safety for classes or fields. Disables null safety for classes, fields or expressions if
            provided with `Off` as an argument. See [cr-null-safety](https://haxe.org/manual/cr-null-safety.html).
Declares a class or interface that is used to interoperate with Objective-C code.
Associates an interface with, or describes a function in, a native Objective-C protocol.
Declares an abstract field as being an operator overload. See [types-abstract-operator-overloading](https://haxe.org/manual/types-abstract-operator-overloading.html).
Marks the field of a structure as optional. See [types-nullability-optional-arguments](https://haxe.org/manual/types-nullability-optional-arguments.html).
Allows the field to be called with different argument types. See [target-javascript-external-libraries](https://haxe.org/manual/target-javascript-external-libraries.html).
Keeps the value of static variables in macro context across compilations.

Adds a PHP attribute to the annotated symbol. Meta argument expects a string constant. E.g. `@:php.attribute('\\my\\Attr(123)')`
            will be generated as `#[\my\Attr(123)]` in the compiled php file.
Indicates that static fields of an extern class actually are located in the global PHP namespace.
Indicates that a static var of an extern class is a PHP class constant.

Treat annotated field as special PHP magic field - this meta makes compiler avoid renaming such fields on
            generating PHP code.

Special meta for extern classes which do not have native constructor in PHP, but need a constructor in Haxe
            extern.
Sets the position of a reified expression. See [macro-reification](https://haxe.org/manual/macro-reification.html).
Forces all class fields of inheriting classes to be public.
Marks a class field as being private.
Allow private access to anything for the annotated expression.
Marks a class field as being protected.
Marks a field to be compiled as a native C# property.
Marks a class field, class or expression as pure (side-effect free).
Generates a field with the `readonly` native keyword.
Causes an interface to be removed from all implementing classes before generation.
Allows access to a field only if the specified compiler flag is set. See [lf-condition-compilation](https://haxe.org/manual/lf-condition-compilation.html).
Abstract fields marked with this metadata can be used to resolve unknown fields.
Adds runtime type information. See [cr-rtti](https://haxe.org/manual/cr-rtti.html).
Marks an abstract as being a runtime value.
Used by hxcpp to mark a custom coreType abstract.
Translates method calls into calling object directly. See [target-javascript-external-libraries](https://haxe.org/manual/target-javascript-external-libraries.html).
The native semantics of the type.
Generates a native setter function on the given field.

Includes a given .wav or .mp3 file into the target SWF and associates it with the class (must extend `flash.media.Sound`).

Source code filename for external class.
Instances of this type can only appear on the stack.
Used to declare a native C# attribute or a native Java metadata; is type checked.
Marks a class definition as a struct.

Allows one to initialize the class with a structure that matches constructor parameters.
Adds a `SuppressWarnings` annotation for the generated Java class.
Indicates that the first parameter of static call should be treated as a template argument.
Adds a `throws` declaration to the generated function.
Specifies that the field of the abstract is a cast operation to the type identified in the function. See [types-abstract-implicit-casts](https://haxe.org/manual/types-abstract-implicit-casts.html).
Adds the `transient` flag to the class field.
Allows transitive casts with an abstract.
